Commentary.Commentary: Join us back in a short while as the Black Caps get ready for a fight for survival that is to make for an interesting run chase.

South Africa will be eyeing to end their drought of not winning a Test since 2015. Will we see Williamson and Co. coming up with a better show with the willow? Or will the Proteas clean them up? More than 5 sessions to go, a result is an assurity.

The Kiwis have an uphill task ahead of them and they will have to bat and bat out of their skins to save this game. Nonetheless, South Africa will now fancy their chances to go out and replicate what they did in the first innings. The quickies will be licking their lips to have a go on the deck that has just too much for the pacers. With the pitch already misbehaving, it would be highly interesting to see what happens next.

Here comes the signal from Francois du Plessis, they have decided they have enough runs on the board. So, a batting collapse on day 3 hasn't really affected the home side much as they have still managed to post a mammoth target of 400 runs in front of the Kiwis. It was all about de Kock and Temba Bavuma in this innings. The duo stood tall and dealt with the pacers to swell the lead of 267 runs that they had got.
Good length ball outside off, Piedt chooses to leave it. Faf du Plessis waves his arms from the pavilion and that signals the end of the innings! SOUTH AFRICA DECLARE WITH A LEAD OF 399!
Shorter ball outside off, Dane raises his bat high to defend it but fails to make contact.
Bouncer! Piedt ducks under the bouncer at the last moment.
Full on middle, defended behind the line of the delivery and the batsmen run a single.
The ball is way outside the off stump, easy leave for Temba.
Back of a length ball on off, defended off the front foot and into the ground.
NEIL WAGNER comes into the attack!
Short ball on off, Dane looks to defend it off the back foot but misjudges the bounce and the ball goes off his gloves and hits him on the stomach.
Full delivery on the stumps, worked to mid-wicket.
Angling in, the ball strikes Peidt on the thigh pad. There is a slight appeal but the umpire isn't interested.
Dane chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
In the corridor outside off, left alone.
Full on off, driven through mid off for a single.
Shorter ball outside off, played to point.
Full delivery around off, driven through mid off.
Length ball, defended off the back foot by Piedt.
Shorter ball outside off, Dane looks to play it but misses.
Bavuma shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the backfoot for a single.
Full delivery, Temba lets the ball go outside his off stump.

Was that out? Unfortunately not. Length ball around off, the ball turns in to beat the inside edge and hit Dane high on the pads. There is a big appeal but the umpire doesn't give it. The replays show that it was a good call as the ball goes going too high above the stumps.
The ball is way outside the off stump, easy leave for Dane.
BEATEN! Peidt is greeted by an inswinger that passes through the bap between bat and pad and the ball passes over the stumps.
DANE PEIDT is the new man in.

OUT! UPROOTED! That was some swing! Length ball outside off, Vernon thinks it will hold its line and shoulders his arms. Southee changes his grip through and rolls his wrists to send the ball twirling back in and crashing into the off stump to send it cartwheeling. That is a sight that any fast bowler would love to behold!
Full delivery, driven through mid on.
Bouncer! Philander sways away from it.
Short ball around off, Bavuma lifts his bat parallel to the ground and defends it.
Slow ball outside off, Bavuma shoulders his arms.
Back of a length delivery, Bavuma defends it off the back foot.
Well bowled! Bavuma is quick to react to that one, withdrawing back into the crease to defend it but he misjudges the line and misses the ball. It beats his outside edge and goes to the keeper.
Fuller delivery outside off, played to point.
The ball is way outside the off stump, easy leave for Temba.
Bavuma does well to defend this one. He plays it with soft hands to the off side and gets a single to retain the strike.
Back of a length ball outside off, defended off the back foot.
Very short and outside off, Bavuma lets it through.
Bavuma is back! Short on middle and off, Bavuma pulls it sharply through square leg for a couple.
In the corridor outside off, Bavuma shoulders arms.
Bavuma has been hit on his right elbow and the physio is on the field looking at it. That was a nasty blow so let's hope he is alright.
OUCH! Shorter ball on middle and off, it shapes in a bit to beat the inside edge and cracks into his right elbow and is deflected onto his pads. Bavuma is down on the ground and needs assistance.
Full outside off, driven through the covers.
On the stumps and angled in, Philander plays it to mid-wicket.
Full on leg, worked down the leg side.
FOUR! Text book! Philander just had to put that one away. Short and outside off, Vernon rocks back and cuts it through point. He finds the gap and the ball makes it to the fence.
Full delivery on middle, Philander works it to the leg side.
Vernon chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Bouncer! Bavuma ducks to let it through.
Full outside off, driven towards mid on.

NOT OUT! Decision stays as it is! A length delivery down the leg side, Bavuma looks to flick it to the leg side but appears to be narrowly beaten. The ball goes on to the keeper, who dives to his left and takes a good grab. There is a big appeal but the umpire doesn't agree though and the fielding side confer briefly before going in for the review. The replays show that the ball was close but not close enough. The Ultra Edge says a different story with a tiny blip from the contact with the ball. However, the camera shows that the bat was nowhere near the ball at that point and the contact could be from when it grazed his pads. All said, that was a beauty from Southee, tempting Bavuma to go for it and it nearly worked.
A caught behind appeal is turned down by the umpire. Kane Williamson has opted for the review...
Wide outside off stump, the batsman leaves it alone.
Full ball on off, driven through mid off.
Fullish ball outside off, Philander looks to defend it with very soft hands. He manages it only get a bottom edge and the ball goes past the man at slip who chases after it. The batsmen get a triple.
Short ball on leg, Bavuma stays back and works it down the leg side.
Good length ball on the pads, played to mid-wicket.
Full ball outside off, driven through the covers.
Fullish ball and well outside off, it's an easy leave for Bavuma.
Fuller ball on middle and leg, worked down the leg side for a single.
BEATEN! Excellently bowled! Good length delivery outside off, Philander looks to defend it but the ball holds its line to beat the outside edge.
This one is down the leg side and Bavuma leaves it alone.
Length ball outside off, defended to point.

FOUR! Another outside edge! This time Bavuma sees it go all the way. Length ball and outside off, Bavuma opens the face of his bat to 45 degrees, taking an intentional outside edge. The ball goes between the slip and keeper and makes its way to the boundary at third man.
Bouncer! Bavuma is quick to let it through to the keeper.

EDGED! Length ball outside off, Philander opens his bat a tad and gets an outside edge. The ball scrapes past the slip fielder and goes through third man. The fielder chases it down and the batsmen get a triple.
Fuller ball on the pads, Bavuma flicks it to square leg for a single.
In the channel outside off, left alone.
Around the wicket and this is a short delivery outside off. Phliander looks to pull it but misses it completely.
Around off and shaping in, Philander plays it to mid-wicket.
Fuller ball on the stumps, played off the front foot and into the ground.

Well bowled! Fuller ball on leg, Vernon looks to defend it but does not anticipate that inswinger. It takes an inside edge and hits him on the pads. There is a brief appeal but the umpire is not interested.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
Full ball outside off, driven through the covers.
Back of a length delivery, defended off the back foot.

FOUR! EDGED! Bavuma got lucky. Length ball around off, Bavuma looks to block it with a straight bat. The ball takes and outside edge and its pace is enough to carry it past the slips and to the third man boundary.
Bavuma lets the ball go outside his off stump.
In the corridor outside off, Bavuma chooses to leave it.
Full on the stumps, defended behind the line of the delivery.
TIM SOUTHEE to bowl from the other end.
Down the leg side, Bavuma looks to flick it but it glances off his gloves and goes fine down the leg side. The batsmen run a single but the umpire signals a leg bye.
Fuller ball outside off, blocked off the front foot back to the bowler.
In the corridor outside off, Temba shoulders his arms.
Short ball on off, Bavuma lets it through.
Good length delivery around off, punched to the covers.
Length ball on the pads, Bavuma looks to defend it off the front foot but gets and outside edge and the ball goes to the off side.

The players and umpires are on the field. TEMBA BAVUMA and VERNON PHILANDER will continue from where they left off yesterday. TRENT BOULT to start off with the bowling proceedings with a slip and a gully in place. Here we go...

There are two days to go and the Proteans have put up a huge 372-run lead so far. But all is not lost for the Kiwis as something clicked for their bowlers yesterday and they are looking sharper than ever. In this crucial stage of the game, South Africa will look to build upon their lead to set a truly daunting target. However, the tourists have seen a glimmer of hope and will be eager to seize it. Stay tuned as we get down to another thrilling day of cricket.

Hello and welcome back to the 4th day of the final Test between South Africa and New Zealand. Yesterday, skipper Kane Williamson put in a determined and admirable batting effort to take New Zealand to a very modest 214 and avoid the  follow-on. Quinton de Kock got South Africa off to a blazing start but the Kiwi pacers struck in quick succession to bring the hosts to a grinding halt. 6 wickets down now and they will have to rely on the solid Temba Bavuma to see them through.
... Day 4, Session 1 ...

Temba Bavuma is still out there and is looking rock solid. New Zealand need just 4 wickets to clean the opposition. South Africa would eye to get somewhere near 450. This match seems to be heading towards an enthralling end. We are eagerly waiting for how the penultimate day pans out. Do join us at 1330 IST tomorrow to catch all the action. Until next time, it is goodbye from us. Cheers!

South Africa won't be unhappy at the end of the day as they have a solid lead of 372 in their kitty but a better batting performance would have seen them walking towards the dressing room with their heads high. Barring Quinton de Kock nobody showed the stomach to fight. He scored a 50 and departed soon after. This also happens to be only the 4th instance in Test history that a keeper has scored fifties in both innings as an opener.

After handing a lead of 267 runs to the Proteas, the Kiwis had to do something miraculous with the cherry. Boult and Southee kept the hopes alive and scalped 4 wickets between them while Wagner and Bracewell settled for 1 apiece. Overall, they would be really happy with the collective efforts displayed by their pacers.

That brings us to the end of another riveting day of Test cricket! At the start of the day, one would have expected New Zealand to crumble towards the end but boy, they have proved it wrong. The first two sessions belonged to the hosts but the Kiwis made a resounding comeback in the last session as they have removed 6 of the South African batsmen.
Length ball outside off, Vernon chooses to leave it. THAT'S STUMPS ON DAY 3! SA LEAD BY 372.
Back of a length ball on the stumps, Philander looks to defend it off the back foot and is struck on the gloves.
Wide outside off stump, Vernon leaves it alone.
Nicely bowled! Back of a length ball angled in, Philander gets an inside edge and the ball thuds into his pads.
Short ball around off, played to point.
Good length ball, defended off the front foot with the full face of the bat to the leg side.
Temba chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
FOUR! SWIPED! Bavuma doesn't hold back on that one. Shortish delivery, Bavuma rears up and pulls it. The short leg fielder cringes away as the ball flies to the mid-wicket boundary.
Well bowled! Shorter ball outside off, it shapes in a bit and just beats the outside edge of Bavuma's bat. That was a great effort from Neil!
Bouncer! Bavuma ducks under the bouncer at the last moment.
Full on the stumps, defended from behind the line of the delivery.
Back of a length ball on middle, comes at a nice height too. Philander swivels and pulls it through mid-wicket for a single.
Angles it full on middle and leg, Philander flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
In the channel on off, Philander allows it to go through to the keeper behind.
Fuller length delivery on off, Philander defends it off the front foot.
In the channel outside off, Vernon makes a leave to the keeper.
Length ball outside off, Philander wanted to leave it alone but was a bit too late to do so. The ball catches the toe end of the bat and is lucky as the ball didn't carry to the man at second slip.
Good length ball outside off, pushed towards covers.
In the channel outside off, Temba lets it go through to the keeper.
Bavuma covers the line and defends it towards covers.
The ball is way outside the off stump, easy leave for the batsman.
Back of a length ball on middle, Bavuma ducks it sanity.
Touch short on middle, pulled through square leg for a single.
Short of a length delivery on middle, Philander ducks to evade it.
Touch short and around middle, Bavuma feels to go after it. He looks to pull but gets it off the bottom edge towards mid on.
Gets behind the line and defends it down.
Fourth in a row! Good length ball outside off, Bavuma lets it go.
On a length and around off, Bavuma lifts his bat and lets it go.
in the channel outside off, Temba has got nothing to do with it.
Good length ball on off, it's been left alone with ease.
Tim Southee to bowl.
Full outside off, defended behind the line of the delivery.
Vernon Philander is the next batsman in.

OUT! GONE! Wagner strikes! This was cleverly done. After a series of short deliveries, van Zyl was certainly not expecting a fuller ball outside off. He steps forward and looks to defend it to the covers but the ball swings away gently and clips the outside edge. It goes to the keeper who bends and pouches the sitter. NZ are making good headway into the line-up.
Short ball outside off, played to point.
Bouncer! Well left by van Zyl.
Another short delivery that Stiaan defends to the leg side.
Back of a length ball around off, van Zyl stands tall and defends it.
Bavuma picked that bouncer early and let it through to the keeper.
Full on the stumps, defended off the front foot with a straight bat.
Length delivery on the stumps, van Zyl does well to pull it to the leg side for a single.
Full delivery, Bavuma edges it to mid-wicket for a single.
Bouncer! Bavuma sees it coming and ducks.

FOUR! Blasted! Full on the stumps, Bavuma bounds foward and drives it strongly to the man at mid-wicket. The ball has gathered too much momentum and gets past him to carry on its way to the fence. Bavuma moves to 20 with that.
Ending with a zinger, van Zyl ducks under that bouncer.
Shortish ball on middle, defended off the back foot.
Straight and zipping slightly down the leg side, Stiaan leaves it.
Length ball around off, defended to the off side.
Back over the wicket for Wagner, he launches that shortish delivery on middle and leg. Van Zyl looks to pull it but fails to make contact.
Wide! Way down the leg side, van Zyl merely follows it with his eyes as it goes past. The umpire spreads his arms and signals a wide.
Back of a length ball on middle and off, blocked off the back foot back to the bowler.
Short ball outside off, played to point.
Shorter ball outside off, defended to short extra cover.
Back of a length on middle and leg, flicked to the leg side for a single.
Shortish ball around off, van Zyl looks to hook it but gets an inside edge and the ball cracks back onto his pads.
Length ball on off, defended off the back foot.
BEATEN! That was a close one! Length ball outside off and van Zyl looks  to defend it with a straight bat but the ball carries on in its line and beats the outside edge.
Good length delivery on middle and leg, defended to mid on.
Length ball, defended off the back foot.
Back of a length ball, Bavuma is taken by surprise but does well to defend it from within the crease.
Down the leg side, Bavuma goes for it but misses.
Bouncer! Bavuma ducks in time to let that one go over him.
Short ball, van Zyl nudges it to backward square leg for a single.

FOUR! Bavuma puts it away! Back of a length ball outside off, Temba waits late, very late and then opens the face of his bat and drives it through point for a beautifully placed boundary. Great way to end the over.
Length ball on middle and leg, flicked to the leg side for a single.
In the channel outside off, van Zyl shoulders arms and a groan goes up as the ball swings back in.
Another short one and van Zyl turns away, accepting a blow to his arm from that one.
Choker! Short ball on middle, van Zyl turns away, taking his eyes off the ball and the ball hits him high in the chest.
Bouncer! Around off and swinging in, van Zyl leans back and lets it through.
Wide down the leg side, Bavuma sees it coming early and shoulders his arms.
Angling across, a shortish delivery outside off that Bavuma shies away from.
Bouncer! Bavuma bends low and the ball passes overhead.
Down the leg side, Bavuma looks to flick it but misses.
On middle and leg, worked to the leg side for a single.
Short leg in position with a man at leg gully.
Shortish ball on off, van Zyl blocks it back to the bowler off the back foot.
Short ball outside off, left alone.
Back of a length ball and outside off, defended to point from deep within the crease.
Fuller ball on middle and off, defended from within the crease.
Another close one! Back of a length ball outside off, Bavuma gets an outside edge on it and it goes to the slips on one bounce.
Good length ball on middle and off, it cuts in sharply and strikes the batsman high on the pads. An appeal goes up only to be stifled just as quickly.
Length ball around off, played to point.
Drinks break...
Bouncer! Van Zyl ducks under it at the last moment. SA are 350 runs ahead.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Short ball, Van Zyl shows the full face of his bat and defends it off the back foot.
Shortish ball on leg, Bavuma does well to flick it to the leg side for a single.
Short ball outside off, Bavuma leaves it.
Back of a length ball, Bavuma stands tall and blocks it off the back foot.
Back of a length delivery, punched off the back foot to the off side.
Shorter ball on off, defended off the back foot.
Bouncer! Stiaan does well to evade it.
Van Zyl defends it from within the crease.
Well outside off, left alone.
Stiaan van Zyl is the new man in.

OUT! Beauty from Bracewell! That ends a fantastic innings from de Kock! Shorter ball on off, the delivery carved its way through the air and swung back in to completely take de Kock by surprise. He is cramped inside the crease and raises his bat to fend it off. The ball takes a top edge and arcs across to gully and Williamson takes a couple of steps forward to take a simple catch. SA were bound to lose a wicket so late into the game.
Full outside off, Bavuma drives it through the covers for a couple.
Full delivery around off, driven to mid off.
Bouncer! One too many short balls! Bavuma gets low and avoids it. The umpire signals a no ball.
Back of a length ball, defended from within the crease.
Shorter ball, Bavuma looks to hook it but misses.
Bouncer! Bavuma ducks to let it through.
Wide outside off stump, Bavuma leaves it alone.
4th Test fifty for Quinton de Kock.

FOUR! Back-to-back fifties for de Kock! Around the wicket and Bracewell pitches that length delivery on middle and leg. De Kock goes back and closes the face of his bat to nudge the ball through fine leg and finds the boundary. An excellent knock to put some life back into the batting.
Length ball outside off, Bavuma bends his knees and cuts it sharply through point for a single.
Full on middle, driven to mid on.
Length ball outside off, luring Bavuma out and he wisely lets it through.
Wide outside off again, Bavuma leaves it.
Way outside off, it's an easy decision for Bavuma to shoulder arms.
Angles a length delivery on the pads, de Kock flicks it towards mid-wicket.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Fuller length delivery on middle, de Kock looks to flick but gets a leading edge towards covers.

NOT OUT! Wagner bangs it short on middle, gets some bounce off the deck. de Kock looks to ride the bounce and as a result he goes for the pull. He completely misses and Watling behind the stumps grabs it. The Kiwis start to appeal and the umpire says not out. Williamson opts for the review and replays aren't conclusive enough as there isn't any part of the wood seen before going to the keeper. The decision stays as it is.
New Zealand have taken a review against de Kock for caught behind!
Bouncer! The batsman ducks under the bouncer at the last moment.
FOUR! Easy for de Kock! Good length delivery on middle, de Kock walks across and pulls it through backward square leg for a racy boundary.
NEIL WAGNER is brought into the attack now!
Good length ball on middle, worked through mid-wicket for a single.
The batsman gets a leading edge on that one.
Good length ball outside off, punched through covers. It's hit in the gap and gets a couple.
Another short ball on middle, de Kock ducks to evade it.
FOUR BYES! Short of a length ball on off, de Kock ducks to evade it. The ball goes well over Watling who tries his best to stop it with a leap.
Anlges a length ball from round the wicket, Bavuma gets across and flicks it through mid on for a single.
Length ball on middle and leg, tucked towards mid-wicket for a single.
Very full and around off, driven towards the man at covers by TB.
Short of a length ball on off, Bavuma gets back and punches it straight to the man at point.
In the channel outside off, Temba leaves it alone.
Fuller length delivery on off, Bavuma drives it hard but finds Boult at covers.
Good length delivery on off, de Kock punches it through covers for a single.
Dough Bracewell into the attack now!
The ball is way outside the off stump, easy leave for the batsman.
Fuller and on the pads, clipped through mid-wicket for a double.
FOUR! Glorious! Fuller length delivery on the stumps, Bavuma leans into it and eases it down to mid on for a boundary.
The batsman fails to put bat on ball.
Fuller length delivery on off, defended off the front foot.
Good length ball on off, Bavuma looks to defend but gets beaten up.
de Kock drives it straight to mid off.

FIVE WIDES! Southee bangs it short on middle, bounces really very high after hitting the deck. de Kock stays inside the crease, the ball goes over him and Watling for a boundary. Too high for anyone,, unstoppable!
Good length ball around off, Quinton shoulders his arms to that one.
The ball has taken the inside edge onto the pads.
Good length ball outside off, punched towards covers.
Fuller length ball on middle, driven down the ground for a couple.
Fuller length delivery on off, driven towards mid off,
On a length and outside off, Bavuma defends it towards covers.
Temba has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
After a yorker, Boult bangs it short this time, little man ducks to evade it.
Bowls a yorker on middle, Bavuma digs it out in time.
Temba Bavuma is the new man in, replacing Faf du Plessis!

OUT! Caught! Trent Boult gets his second wicket too. He bowls it from over the wicket outside off, it bounces a bit after pitching. Takes du Plessis by surprise and as a result he gets an outside edge towards first slip where Ross Taylor takes a good catch diving forward. Boult is all jovial and why wouldn't he be?
On a length and outside off, punched off the back foot towards covers for a single.
Drinks are on the field!
Good length delivery on off, du Plessis has got nothing to do with that one.
On middle and off, bunted down to mid on.
Touch short on middle, de Kock gets across and tucks it through square leg for a single.
Back of a length delivery on off, QDK lifts his bat and lets it go through towards his counterpart.
Banged short on middle, de Kock ducks to evade it.
Fuller length delivery on middle, Quinton covers the line and defends it back to Southee.
Good length delivery outside off, Faf gets inside the line but the ball moves away and just goes past the outside edge to BJ behind.
Short of a length delivery around leg, du Plessis looks to pull but misses.
Landed outside off, pushed towards point.
Full and angled on middle, eased down to mid on.
On a length and around off, Faf looks to defend but gets hit on the pads.
Touch full and around off, de Kock leans forward and drives it through covers for a single.
In the corridor outside off, FAf shoulders his arms to that one.
The batsman fails to put bat on ball.
Faf lets the ball go outside his off stump.
du Plessis shoulders arms to let that one through.
Good length ball on off, du Plessis looks to poke at it but gets beaten up.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Fuller and angled on middle, clipped through mid-wicket for a single by Faf. And he will keep strike.
Short and down the leg side, du Plessis still goes after it but misses. A good take by Watling behind by moving to his left.
Full and angled on middle, flicked through mid-wicket.
On a length and around off, Faf gets back and crunches it through covers for a couple.
Good length delivery on off, punched off the back foot towards covers.
In the channel outside off, du Plessis shoulders his arms to that one.
The batsman picked that bouncer early and let it through to the keeper.

FOUR! Up and over! This upper cut certainly reminded me of Sehwag! Short of a length ball on off, de Kock senses it early. Prepares himself and nails the upper cut to perfection over the slip cordon. One bounce and into the fence she goes.

Bowls it fuller on the pads, du Plessis gets across and flicks it through mid-wicket. Wagner gives it a chase and does well to scoop the ball back. The TV umpire watches it from every angle and then with the help of the magnifying glass he zooms to see if the ball made contact with the hand when Neil touched the rope. After a long delay he says it's a clean stop. Three runs taken nonetheless.
Beaten! On a length and outside off, du Plessis this time looks to poke at it but is beaten up.
Serves it wide outside off, du Plessis doesn't even try to play at it. Good thinking by the skipper there.
A length ball outside off, de Kock slashes it through point for a single.
Fuller length delivery on middle, du Plessis gets forward and drives it towards the man at mid on.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
On a length and outside off, Faf has got nothing to do with that one.
In the corridor of uncertainty, du Plessis shoulders his arms to that one.
Touch full and around off, driven through covers for a single.
Full and angled on the pads, de Kock defends it towards the leg side.
On a length and around off, Faf leaves it for the keeper.
Faf du Plessis is the new man in, replacing Duminy!

OUT! JP you gotta go! Southee gets another one in the same over, boy, this is some pace bowling! Fires a full ball, at 137 kph, nips in after hitting the deck. Duminy looks to flick it across the line but completely misses and is hit on the pads. Tim turns back to appeal and the umpire raises his dreaded finger. Duminy looks at de Kock and then keeps his bat near his armpit and starts to walk back. New Zealand get what they wanted.
Outside off, Duminy doesn't fiddle at it.
Good length ball on off, Duminy shoulders his arms to that one.
JP Duminy walks in next.

OUT! Got him... yes gone! That's a huge, huge wicket! Southee serves a full length delivery on off, curls away after pitching. Amla is tempted to go after it and in the end pays the price for the same. The ball takes the outside part of the willow and flies in the safe hands of the Kiwi opener Martin Guptill at second slip. He doesn't drop many and Amla walks back without troubling the scorers much.
In the channel outside off, Amla lifts his bat and makes an easy leave to the keeper.
The batsman picked that bouncer early and let it through to the keeper.
Amla is off the mark! On a length and outside off, Amla looks to poke at it but gets an outside edge past point for a single to get off the mark.
Good length delivery on middle, Amla looks to flick but misses and is hit on the pads.

A loud, loud shout for lbw again! It's not given this time! Can say it was a replica of the previous ball. Pitches this on off, gets it to curl back in and hits Amla on the pads. An appeal is made but umpire Gould shakes his head as he spotted an inside edge there. Replays confirm the same. Seems Boult's ego is hurt after that forgettable first over.
Hashim Amla is the number 3 batsman for South Africa.

OUT! Boult draws first blood! He hurls it on a length and around off, it nips back in deadly. Cook was expecting the ball to shape away but this one curls in only to hit him on the pads right in front of the wickets. Boult turns back to appeal and sees the finger going up much to his delight. Cook walks to his partner and confers if he should take the review. The Protea keeper says no. After being hit for boundaries in his very first over, Boult will have something to smile now. SA lead by 298 runs.

FOUR! Runs coming thick and fast for the Proteas! On a length and moves away after pitching, Cook gets back in the crease, opens the face of the bat and guides it past the man at gully for a boundary.

FOUR! Sweet, absolutely sweet! Fuller length ball on off, de Kock leans into it and caresses it past mid on for a racy boundary. Seems South Africa are in the mood to score quick and declare today itself.

SIX! Mind boggling! QDK is taking the attack to the opposition! Southee bangs this one outside off, had a good height and pace on it. de Kock stays put inside the crease, keeps his bat skywards and hits it over the third man fence for a biggie all the way.
The ball is way outside the off stump, easy leave for the batsman.
Short and wide outside off, cut straight to the man at point.
Fuller length ball on middle, pushed towards mid on off the front foot.
Southee bangs it short on middle, de Kock ducks in sanity.
Short of a length delivery on off, Cook hops a bit and defends it towards the off side.
Full and sprays it on the pads, flicked behind square on the on side for a single. Boult will be happy not to concede another boundary here.

FOUR! If previous two were off the edges this one's off the middle of the bat! That's certainly a confidence inducing shot! Back of a length ball on off, de Kock gets on the top of the bounce and crunches it through covers. No need to run for those! de Kock is off to a flier here, T20 mode?

FOUR! Boult would be saying, seriously? Another edge and it's raced away to the fence. On a length and shapes away a bit, de Kock looks to defend it by getting behind it and ends up getting another thick edge or should I say safe edge which flies past point for a boundary.
FOUR! Edged and away she goes! Boult fires a length ball outside off, de Kock looks to cut it but gets an outside edge through gully and third slip for a boundary.

FOUR! That's slashed by de Kock! He is not afraid from anything! Sees the width offered by Boult and pounces on it in a flash. Hits it hard through point and fetches himself a boundary on his very first ball of this innings.
TRENT BOULT will share the new cherry from the other end!
